hook_gate_detail: hook_rotation show: this_episode #2 Listicle/Number, previous 2026-11-18-gta6-sick-day #1. Script hook_type=2. Opener 'Three launch day mistakes. Number three is the worst.' promises 3 and pays all 3; tease pays off (item 3 = fake site + malware gremlin). Passes. Weakness: 'launch day' of what? Nothing spoken says GTA 6.

landed: 'console' malware claim removed; laptop/phone + 'your device' (scene 10, upload line 1)
tiny coin replaced by neutral box
not_landed_or_new: GTA 6 dropped from spoken hook/caption (new v3 regression, deliberate for word count)
'BONUS PACK' tag on Ultimate box mislabels the edition (see findings)

special_attention.1_gta6_hype: Weak. Spoken script and caption never say GTA 6; only a plain-text sign (frame 0), title and #gta6 carry it. A 1 a.m. scroller hears 'launch day mistakes' with no subject, so it does not ride the hype on the audio/caption track and the Shorts title is not visible in-feed. Cheapest word-neutral fix: make the frame-0 badge read 'GTA 6 LAUNCH DAY' (written form allowed by Rule B for badges) and enlarge the 'GTA 6' store sign behind Benny, zero spoken words changed. Optional stronger fix: say 'Three G T A six mistakes. Number three is the worst.' replacing 'launch day' (about +2 words, ~70 words, ~30.4 s, still in range; caption 'G T A 6' per Rule B).
special_attention.2_ultimate_ab: Mostly fair now. Voice says Ultimate costs $20 more; box is neutral; A/B is 'Ultimate, or keep twenty dollars?' with no mocking art. Residual tilt: item 1 sits under 'mistakes', and the wallet-shrinks gag still frames spending as the error, so A reads as the wrong answer. Also the 'BONUS PACK' tag is inaccurate: source says the bonus pack is a separate pre-order bonus (contents unlisted); Ultimate adds in-game vehicles, weapon variants, storefronts and a mission. Change tag to 'EXTRAS' or 'IN-GAME EXTRAS'. Dilemma works as comment bait.
special_attention.3_malware_claim: Faithful. CyberInsider/NordVPN: dozens of malicious sites impersonating Rockstar/storefronts, fake pre-orders, malware disguised as installers. 'Dozens of fake sites exist. Some spread malware.' invents no counts or platform; 'your device' is safe. Pass.
special_attention.4_nfa: Acceptable. On-screen only, 3x, plus 'Not financial advice.' in the upload description. The topic is a consumer pay-later survey, not investment advice, so spoken NFA is not required; Rule C is touched only mildly (screen says a bit more than voice, a disclaimer, not a claim). Caveat: it breaks the <=5 on-screen words per moment target in scenes 3 and 12 (see findings).

ok: 3 mistakes: say 'Three', text 'Three', on_screen '3 MISTAKES', red '3', title/upload '3'.
$20: say 'twenty dollars', text '$20', counter '+$20 MORE', B row 'KEEP $20', upload '$20'. Same figure everywhere (Rule A).
47%: say 'forty-seven percent', text '47%', badge/counter 47%, grid 47 of 100, upload 47%; all 'pay later users', 'paid late'.
'Dozens of fake sites' say = text = headline; 'malware' stamp = spoken; 'your device' headline matches quip 'Not my device!'.
Item numbering: voice One/Two/Three = on-screen rows 1/2/3.
Upload: title pays off, line 1 is a real hook (not title copy), 4 hashtags, 'Not financial advice.', sources named.
findings: 'BONUS PACK' tag on the Ultimate box (scene 3, 12) contradicts the source (Ultimate = in-game extras; bonus pack = pre-order bonus). Rule C: screen says something different from the facts. Use 'EXTRAS'.
Rule B: no acronym in say/text, so no mismatch; but 'GTA 6' appears only on a sign/title/hashtag (see special attention 1).

Scene 6 stacks LENDINGTREE SURVEY + PAY LATER USERS + 47% + PAID LATE; scene 12 shows 'A: ULTIMATE / B: KEEP $20' + NOT FINANCIAL ADVICE. Both exceed 5 on-screen words at one moment. Shrink the badges/NFA to a tiny footer or show NFA only on scene 3.
Line 1 says 'launch day mistakes' but the fake site is a pre-order (pre-launch) and BNPL is generic. Minor; item 3 reads fine because Benny is in a launch-day line.
Upload description says 'last year' for 47% while voice/screen say nothing about the period; harmless but source is 'past year' (survey Mar 2026).
Scenes planned 13 vs QA target 8-12 (scene-format allows 8-14): merge scenes 12 and 13 or 8 and 9 if the renderer allows.

fixes: Hook 7 / Line 1 and scene 1: spoken hook never names GTA 6. Cheapest: badge 'GTA 6 LAUNCH DAY' and a bigger 'GTA 6' sign at frame 0 (no word change). Better: 'Three G T A six mistakes. Number three is the worst.' (caption 'G T A 6', ~70 words, ~30.4 s).

Surprise 7 / Line 4: 47% is the only 'wait, what' and is a generic BNPL stat. Make the grid reveal punchier ('almost half' visually, snap to red) and keep voice = '47%'; optionally pay it off with Benny gasping on 'forty-seven'.

Stakes 8 / Line 2: item 1 is not obviously a 'mistake'. Add a visual beat showing the wallet shrinking after 'twenty dollars more' (already planned) and keep Ultimate neutral; consider 'Ultimate costs you twenty dollars more' framed as a choice, not an error, since the A/B treats it as one.
Facts 8 / scenes 3 and 12: replace the 'BONUS PACK' tag with 'EXTRAS' (source: in-game vehicles, weapons, storefronts, mission).
Clarity 8 / Line 4: 'LendingTree' is a brand a non-native listener may not catch, and 'pay later users' is unexplained. The badge helps; keep it readable (but see on-screen word count).
Format / scenes 6 and 12: cut stacked on-screen text to <= 5 words per moment; show 'NOT FINANCIAL ADVICE' only once, small.
